memberdef.name: findSimilarAdapters

briefdescription.para: Find the top-k adapters most similar to the given adapter.

detaileddescription.para: Delegates to the wired TensorFingerprintGraph. By default, key-based similarity uses TT cosine (inner-product based). If setExactSimilarityFn() is set, that backend overrides scoring.

simplesect.para: // STUB/SIMULATION NOTE (STUB #177): // Purpose: Expose adapter similarity search backed by fingerprint graph. // Activation: Only when setFingerprintGraph() has been called. // Production Delta: Uses exact TT cosine by default and supports // optional backend override via setExactSimilarityFn(); does not yet // include ANN acceleration/indexing for large candidate pools. // Removal Plan: Q3 2027 — replace with full TTTrain::innerProduct() // similarity + HNSW index over fingerprints (Phase 4 AdaLoRA bridge).
